sentences.text: Fossils of Diandongpetalichthys include one complete skull roof, several incomplete skull roofs, parts of the trunk shield, and spines.
Based on better-preserved specimens showing features similar to primitive arthrodires, Diandongpetalichthys is now classified as a basal member of the order Petalichthyida.

This extinct placoderm lived in China during the Early Devonian period, specifically in the Lochkovian stage between 419.62 and 413.02 million years ago. Its fossils were found in the non-marine Xishancun Formation at Liaojiaoshan Hill in Qujing, Yunnan.
